now-sdk cicd rollback

Roll back an installed application to a previous version

Options:
  -d, --debug         Print debug output              [boolean] [default: false]
  -a, --auth          Credential alias to use for authentication with instance
                                                                        [string]
  -o, --output        Output format: json for a machine-readable envelope, raw
                      to unquote the --select result
                                               [string] [choices: "json", "raw"]
  -s, --select        Dot/bracket path to extract from the output (e.g.
                      "result.links.progress.id"). Implies machine-readable
                      output; pair with --output raw for direct use in shell
                      command substitution.                             [string]
      --wait          Wait for the operation to finish by polling its progress
                                                       [boolean] [default: true]
      --poll-timeout  Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for the operation to
                      finish                          [number] [default: 900000]
      --scope         Scope name of the application to target (mutually
                      exclusive with --app-sys-id; prefer --app-sys-id when
                      known — it identifies the app directly)           [string]
      --app-sys-id    sys_id of the application (sys_app) to target (mutually
                      exclusive with --scope). Defaults from now.config.json
                      (scopeId) when run inside a Fluent project and neither
                      --scope nor --app-sys-id is given                 [string]
      --app-version   Version expected after the rollback completes. For rolling
                      back an App Customization install, set this to the base
                      application version expected afterward. CLI flag is
                      --app-version (not --version) to avoid colliding with
                      yargs' reserved --version/-v flag      [string] [required]
  -h, --help          Show help                                        [boolean]
  -v, --version       Show version number                              [boolean]
